description: MetroLink will provide a high speed, high capacity, high frequency, modern and efficient public transport service for passengers travelling along the Swords/Airport to City Centre corridor in Dublin, which will be capable of integration with other modes of public transport. Further information on MetroLink is available at www.metrolink.ie/ In advance of the MetroLink main infrastructure works contracts, TII will commence the procurement of the Enabling Works Programme. The Enabling Works Programme comprises the establishment of a suite of framework agreements and qualification systems select contractors to deliver enabling works which will commence in advance of the main infrastructure works contracts (in respect of civil engineering, tunnelling and station works). The enabling works will include the removal and/or relocation of existing utilities, archaeology, heritage items (for storage/replacement) and buildings from site and undertaking other survey activities. To deliver the enabling and advance works for MetroLink, TII intends to establish 3 no. multi-party framework agreements as listed below each through a negotiated procedure with a prior call for competition. • Enabling Works and Specialist Heritage Works Framework; • Utilities Framework; and • Civils Enabling Works Framework. TII also intends to establish a qualification system for independent environmental monitoring and a qualification system for archaeology services as part of the Enabling Works Programme. The proposed duration of the framework agreements is 8 years with an option to extend for 4 years to facilitate the procurement of any associated works that may be required over the duration of the Frameworks. This PIN is in connection with the Enabling Works and Specialist Heritage Works Framework. The purpose of this PIN is to alert the market to TII’s intention to undertake market consultation and subsequently commence a procurement in Q3 2025. It is anticipated that the prequalification documentation will be issued in Q3 2025 with the instructions to tenderers issued in Q4 2025 or Q1 2026. TII intends to utilise the NEC4 Engineering Construction Contract (ECC) form of contracts for call offs placed under this framework. The questionnaire is required to be completed in full and returned by the closing date of the 27th May 2025 by 12:00hrs to the following email address supplychainmetrolink@tii.ie. Following receipt of completed questionnaires from interested parties, TII proposes to invite selected participants to provide further information by way of one-to-one clarification meetings to be held on the 3rd , 4th and 5th June 2025. To be deemed an interested party you must register your interest on supplychainmetrolink@tii.ie. TII intends to hold a webinar for the registered interested parties in relation to this procurement on May 29th 2025 at 12:00hrs. description: Located in Noordwijk, ESTEC is a hub for the European Space Agency's activities. The site covers 40 Ha of land and hosts a large Test Centre, high-tech laboratories and office areas for circa 2,700 people working daily on site. ESA Council 316 approved a one-off investment project, the AIP (Accelerated Investment Project) to address obsolescence of general infrastructure of ESTEC and ESOC.The scope of the ESTEC project covers the replacement of approx. 30,000sqm of obsolescent buildings by new modern constructions. The construction of new buildings at ESTEC is intended to take place in phases and to replace the buildings currently located in zones B, C and D. The Project will deliver modern and sustainable buildings, largely for office type of working environment and a number of state-of-the-art laboratory facilities. Given the size and complexity of the construction phases ESA plans to procure, viaa single contract, services for Project Management, Design and Engineering, Project Supervision during the implementation of the project. The Project Management services will be in support to the ESA project manager during the entirety of the project. The Design and Engineering of each of the phases will consist in the production of the engineering packages necessary to issue the tenders for construction and demolition and to support the project with any technical issues arising during the construction. The Project supervision services will be rendered during the construction and demolition phases to monitor compliance of the execution with the design and engineering specifications. ESA intends to select the Contractor in a 2-stage procurement approach. In Stage 1, the Agency shall issue a Call for Expression of Interest' open to all bidders within the ESA Members States, leading to the pre-selection of three bidders to participate in the "Restricted Competition" (Stage 2), which will finally lead to the selection of the Contractor.
